summary: The Network Information Center announces that it is compiling a list of reports from ARPANET sites that matter to participants. This includes reports from ARPA information processing contracts, project hardware and software, and general site reports. Sites were asked to help identify and supply them.

plainLanguage.summary: The Network Information Center was assembling a list and collection of reports from network sites. It asked sites to share their bibliographies and add the NIC to distribution lists for new reports.

sections.title: Collecting Site Reports
sections.content:
The Network Information Center was compiling reports from sites that might interest network participants. It sought reports produced under ARPA information-processing contracts, along with work on information processing, network planning, project hardware and software, and site research topics.

The NIC had received some site report lists, including a bibliography from Peggy Karp, but a complete bibliography had not yet been issued. Demand was growing for both a reference list and access to the reports themselves.
sections.plainLanguage: Research groups were producing reports across the network. The NIC wanted to list those reports and collect copies so participants could find them.

sections.title: How the NIC Would Handle Requests
sections.content:
Requests for reports from ARPA IPT contracts could be forwarded or referred to the NIC. For outside requests, the NIC would not try to supply copies itself. It would provide government ordering information when known or refer the request to the report's originator.

The NIC also intended to provide bibliographic tools to help sites and others refer to network reports.
sections.plainLanguage: The NIC would help people locate reports and direct them to the right source. It would not send copies to outside requesters itself.

sections.title: Request to Network Sites
sections.content: The NIC asked sites to send any existing bibliographies of relevant site-produced reports. It also asked to be included on distribution lists for new relevant reports.
sections.plainLanguage: Sites were asked to share their report lists and send the NIC future reports. This would help the collection grow over time.
